# Atlassian: draw.io icon libraries

Libraries (Shapes tab > More shapes…): Atlassian (legacy) (`atlassian`, 137 shapes), Atlassian (`atlassian2`, 110 shapes).

Atlassian product icons and logos. Atlassian, Jira and Confluence are trademarks of Atlassian. draw.io's terms forbid using its icon sets in Atlassian products.

Vendored unmodified from jgraph/drawio v32.4.1 (commit 9034053fba80a435e27d68d374bc564b83917ae9), src/main/webapp/:

- `img/lib/atlassian/`
- `shapes/mockup/mxMockupButtons.js`
- `shapes/mockup/mxMockupForms.js`
- `shapes/mockup/mxMockupMisc.js`
- `shapes/mxArrows.js`
- `shapes/mxAtlassian.js`
- `shapes/mxAtlassian2.js`
- `shapes/mxBasic.js`
- `stencils/atlassian.xml`
- `stencils/atlassian2.xml`
- `stencils/azure.xml`
- `stencils/basic.xml`
- `stencils/gmdl.xml`
- `stencils/ios7/icons.xml`
- `stencils/mscae/enterprise.xml`
- `stencils/mscae/intune.xml`
- `stencils/office/security.xml`
- `stencils/signs/science.xml`

These icons are third-party artwork that draw.io redistributes. draw.io's README states: "Some icons are
originally defined by third-party copyright holders; we have verified that all original licenses permit use
in this project." The vendor's own terms for its icons apply to their use (typically: depict the vendor's
products in diagrams, do not alter the icons). Railway Drawer does not
modify or recolour them (dark mode keeps their colours) and claims no rights in them; all trademarks belong
to their owners. draw.io's terms for its icon sets and stencil libraries apply as well (public/stencils/LICENSE:
no use as software assets in, or distribution for use with, Atlassian products or the Atlassian marketplace
without written permission; diagrams created with them are not restricted).
